sourceReview: Direct-source review plus focused tests, repository gates, and real Host/Electron execution

findings.issue: Session activity asked the capability cache with an absent workspaceId after a queued turn.
findings.evidence: chat.send propagates canonical workspaceId into ChatAbortControllerEntry; the handler falls back to that owner fact.

findings.issue: A partial current-run observation could copy configured provider/model into effective backend facts.
findings.evidence: backend and model require observed runtime/provider/model to match; tests cover missing observed identity.

findings.issue: A provider-incompatible pinned harness could leak across a resolved model route.
findings.evidence: persisted runtime is revalidated for the resolved provider; an incompatible codex harness on Anthropic falls back to openclaw.

findings.issue: Legacy gateway-methods handling could bypass the new owner dependencies.
findings.evidence: session-activity.test.ts mocks a fresh observation and session owner and passes in the gateway-methods config.

findings.issue: Raw status labels violated i18n conventions.
findings.evidence: configured/effective status text uses four-locale policy.status keys; i18n lint passed.

findings.issue: A previous run context budget could remain effective for a newer run when session, provider, and model were unchanged.
findings.evidence: context promotion now requires an active run plus matching session/provider/model and updatedAt at or after activeRun.startedAtMs; a pre-run regression test passes.

findings.issue: External local-model reviewer exceeded its execution window during cross-process identifier analysis.
findings.evidence: Terminated without a verdict; no unsupported review PASS is claimed.

limits: No live-provider turn was executed in the E2E; effective current-run promotion is proven by owner-boundary tests.
No claim about provider-specific response quality.
